scope.independently_inspected: Target labels, captions and branch layout of all 33 source diagrams, on retained-original contact sheets. Detailed primary-paper methods were not independently reread in full.

findings.description: Background-mentioned adaptations/aliases were promoted to additional target scopes; missing their unshown internals then held the assigned outline. Some listed records also have genuine in-scope problems, so removing extras alone is not evidence of support.
findings.detection: Archived reviewer often accepted honest unresolved scope; host conservatively withheld supported status. Scope07 and later clarify target boundary; targeted fresh runs must verify behavior.

findings.description: An Operation was assigned to another implementation by purpose while its fixed input State retained excluded variant-specific history.
findings.detection: Both fresh reviewers requested correction. Host checked references and I/O consistency but not semantic applicability. Frozen05 research-priority masked the repair action. Runtime08 prioritizes revise and prompts exact-State applicability.

findings.description: Reviewer requested methods=[] for two retained background citations lacking evidence of association to any grouped member; the old schema forced at least one member.
findings.resolution: Root changed working/future08 schema: empty methods permitted only for background/catalogue/unresolved relationships; positive scientific support still needs a method and per-target coverage remains. The exact in-memory reviewer repair now parses. See paper_association_schema_probe.json.

findings.description: Eleven quotes were attached to the correct abstract source IDs but their locator prose named a Results subsection from another abstract.
findings.detection: Fresh reviewer caught all eleven and requested revision. Host checks exact quote membership, not free-text locator entailment. Future08 repair routing addresses the swallowed revision; no native corrected result established by this audit.

findings.description: A family label contextualizing a particular depicted implementation must not be interpreted as a universal claim that every family member has the same preparation. A targeted review must verify the narrower source-supported relationship rather than remove real labels or assume equivalence.

Missing IVT label is a compressed/omitted bridge, not a source assertion that no transcription occurs. Catalogue and secondary review support the bridge; the authored keep_unresolved Correction requests original-primary verification.

Joint affinity binding/capture produces retained and unretained fractions. This is not independent processing compressed under a shared caption. Structural many-to-many must flag routing ambiguity, not automatically reject/split chemistry.
findings.evidence: Independently inspected original source diagram and actual Operation input/output States.

generic_prompt_additions.operation_membership: Assigning a local Operation to a method also assigns its exact declared input/output States. Excluding an upstream transformation does not erase that history from a downstream State. Use a separate source-supported instance for a different interface, or retain a qualified correspondence without same-instance membership.
generic_prompt_additions.evidence_locators: Each locator must identify the same source and passage as its quote. For an unsectioned abstract, use Abstract; do not carry another publication's section heading into the locator.
generic_prompt_additions.already_covered: Scope07 target definition, future08 independent-branch Operation instances, and future08 background PaperMatch methods=[] policy; do not add method-specific instructions.
